stories.title: Starknet May Leave Ethereum for a Quantum-Resistant Layer 1
stories.summary: Starknet may leave Ethereum and build its own quantum-resistant Layer 1 blockchain, according to a CryptoSlate report. The report gives no timeline and does not confirm a final decision. The move would mark a major shift for a network that currently scales Ethereum.
stories.whyItMatters: A departure by a major Ethereum Layer 2 would raise questions about Ethereum's rollup-centric roadmap and about how seriously the industry treats quantum risk.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation or denial from Starknet
Details on the proposed Layer 1 design and timeline
Reaction from Ethereum core developers
questions: Is this an active plan or an early discussion?
What happens to existing Starknet users and liquidity on Ethereum?

sources.title: Starknet considers leaving Ethereum for a quantum-resistant Layer 1

stories.title: XRP ETFs Extend 13-Week Inflow Streak as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana Funds Lose $1.25B
stories.summary: XRP exchange-traded funds extended their inflow streak to 13 straight weeks. In the same period, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana funds lost a combined $1.25 billion. CryptoSlate reported the figures. The split shows investor demand that favors XRP funds over the larger-cap funds.
stories.whyItMatters: Steady ETF inflows are a concrete sign of institutional demand, and a split between XRP and the larger funds shows where that demand concentrates.
whatToWatch: Whether the XRP streak extends past 13 weeks
Whether outflows from Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana funds continue or reverse
questions: What drives the rotation into XRP funds specifically?

sources.title: XRP ETFs extend a 13-week inflow streak as Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana funds shed $1.25 billion

stories.title: Optimism's Unichain Deal Puts More Chains Under One Operator
stories.summary: Optimism signed a deal involving Unichain that puts more chains under one operator in its ecosystem. CryptoSlate frames this as part of a wider trend toward operator concentration in the Optimism Superchain. The report does not detail the deal's exact terms.
stories.whyItMatters: Concentrating chain operation in fewer hands raises centralization and governance questions for a sector built on decentralization claims.
whatToWatch: Further disclosure of the deal's terms
Community or governance response within the Optimism ecosystem
questions: How many chains and how much value now sit under this operator?
What checks exist against one operator controlling multiple chains?

sources.title: Optimism’s Unichain deal will put more chains under one operator

stories.title: Some Aave Loans Sit Near Liquidation With Collateral That Takes Hours to Cash Out
stories.summary: A CryptoSlate report says some loans on the Aave lending protocol sit close to liquidation. Their collateral can take hours to convert to cash. This creates a gap between how fast a position can turn bad and how fast the collateral can sell.
stories.whyItMatters: A liquidity gap like this can turn an orderly liquidation into a disorderly one, with knock-on effects for Aave and connected DeFi markets.
whatToWatch: Whether the affected positions get liquidated or topped up
Any protocol change to the terms for the affected collateral
questions: Which collateral assets are involved, and how large are the at-risk positions?

sources.title: Some Aave loans sit near liquidation with collateral that can take hours to cash out

stories.title: Bitcoin Hedge Funds Face a Liquidation Trap From Collateral Split Across Markets
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that Bitcoin-focused hedge funds face a liquidation risk. Their collateral sits across multiple markets or venues. This split can stop a fund from moving collateral fast enough to meet a margin call in one venue, even when the fund holds enough assets overall.
stories.whyItMatters: A liquidation cascade among leveraged hedge funds can amplify Bitcoin price swings and spill into exchanges and lending markets.
whatToWatch: Signs of forced selling or margin calls across major venues
Whether funds or exchanges change their collateral-sharing arrangements
questions: How large is the exposure, and which venues carry the most risk?

sources.title: Bitcoin hedge funds face a liquidation trap when their collateral is split across markets

stories.title: New iPhone Spyware Hunts for Crypto Wallets, Extracts Data Every 15 Seconds
stories.summary: Security researchers found new spyware that targets iPhones. The spyware hunts for cryptocurrency wallets and pulls data from them every 15 seconds, CryptoSlate reports. The malware appears built specifically to find and harvest wallet data.
stories.whyItMatters: Mobile spyware built for crypto wallets threatens individual holders directly and shows growing sophistication in crypto-focused attacks.
whatToWatch: Apple's response or a security patch
Details on the spyware's distribution method and how many devices it hit
questions: How does the spyware reach devices?
Which wallet apps or wallet types face the most exposure?

sources.title: New iPhone spyware can hunt for crypto wallets and extract their data every 15 seconds

stories.title: Unpatched Lightning Apps Risk Bitcoin Theft From a Reconnect Flaw
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports a flaw in unpatched versions of LDK, the Lightning Dev Kit software behind many Bitcoin Lightning apps. The flaw involves a false reconnect signal. An attacker could use it to steal Bitcoin from affected payment channels.
stories.whyItMatters: Lightning is Bitcoin's main instant-payments layer, so a theft path in widely used node software undermines trust in that layer.
whatToWatch: How fast apps adopt the patched LDK version
Reports of actual exploits in the wild
questions: How many apps and how much value remain exposed on unpatched versions?

sources.title: Lightning apps using unpatched LDK risk Bitcoin theft from a reconnect lie

stories.title: Tokenized Stocks Can Carry Shareholder Rights Without the Same Trading Protections
stories.summary: A CryptoSlate report examines tokenized stocks. These tokens can copy the economic rights of real shares. But they often lack the trading protections that apply on regulated stock exchanges. That gap means buyers may not get the same safeguards as traditional stockholders.
stories.whyItMatters: As tokenized stocks grow, the gap between rights and protections sits in a regulatory gray area that could affect investor outcomes and draw SEC scrutiny.
whatToWatch: Regulatory statements or rules on tokenized securities
Platforms that add disclosures or protections for tokenized stock products
questions: Which specific protections are missing, and on which platforms?
Will regulators require tokenized stocks to carry full securities protections?

sources.title: Tokenized stocks can carry the same rights without the same trading protections

stories.title: XRP's Next Wall Street Push Hits an Unexpected Complication From Ripple
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that XRP's next push into traditional finance hit an unexpected complication tied to Ripple. Ripple is the company closely linked to the XRP token. The report does not specify the nature of the complication.
stories.whyItMatters: Ripple's actions strongly shape XRP's institutional story, so any friction here could slow momentum XRP built with Wall Street players.
whatToWatch: A public response or clarification from Ripple
Any delay or change to the Wall Street expansion plans
questions: What exactly is the complication Ripple introduced?
Does it affect existing institutional partnerships or only new ones?

sources.title: XRP’s next Wall Street expansion comes with an unexpected complication from Ripple

stories.title: Some Kraken Futures Limit Orders Still Fill After a Successful Cancel
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports a bug on Kraken's futures platform. Some limit orders can still execute after a trader gets confirmation that the cancel worked. This creates a mismatch between what the exchange tells traders and what happens to their orders.
stories.whyItMatters: A cancel-confirmation bug on a major futures platform can cause unexpected fills and losses, and it raises questions about order-management reliability.
whatToWatch: Kraken's acknowledgment and fix for the issue
Any compensation process for affected traders
questions: How many traders or orders did this bug affect?
Has Kraken confirmed the root cause?

sources.title: Some Kraken futures limit orders can still fill after a successful cancel
